questions.note: page-gen:battles

questions.question: What is Black Flash?
questions.subject: Black Flash

answer.item: Black Flash is a distortion in space that occurs when cursed energy is applied within 0.000001 seconds (1 microsecond) of a physical hit.

questions.note: prose: Description

questions.question: How much does Black Flash increase the destructive power of a strike?
questions.subject: Black Flash

answer.item: When a jujutsu sorcerer is able to achieve this, their cursed energy flashes black, and the destructive power of their strike is equal to a normal hit to the power of 2.5.

questions.note: prose: Description

questions.question: Why is Black Flash so difficult to use?
questions.subject: Black Flash

answer.item: Using Black Flash requires incredible concentration, and no sorcerer is capable of using it at will, not even Satoru Gojo. It does not occur randomly and requires immense skill and combat potential to pull off.

questions.note: prose: Description

questions.question: What did Gojo speculate about the conditions for Black Flash to occur?
questions.subject: Black Flash

answer.item: Gojo speculated that more conditions must be met for Black Flash to occur, as he would be able to use it at will if applying cursed energy before a blow was the only requirement. He believed that the blend of one's cursed energy, the opponent's cursed energy, one's physical condition, and even the temperature and humidity could affect whether a Black Flash arises or not at a given moment.

questions.note: prose: Description

questions.question: How does Black Flash affect a sorcerer's combat performance?
questions.subject: Black Flash

answer.item: This leads to a greatly increased performance in combat, allowing the user to operate at 120% of their maximum potential.

questions.note: prose: Description

questions.question: Why did Gege Akutami make Black Flash increase a blow's strength to the power of 2.5?
questions.subject: Black Flash

answer.item: In a Volume 6 extra, Gege Akutami explained that he decided to have Black Flash increase the strength of a blow to the power of 2.5 rather than by 2.5x. He did this to make it more impactful and distinct from power-ups in other series, such as the Kaio-ken from Dragon Ball or Char Aznable's MS-06S Zaku II Commander Type from Gundam.
